full.description: This image is a gross pathology photograph showing a cross-section of a heart. The specimen reveals prominent trabeculations and a spongy or web-like appearance within the ventricular myocardium, particularly toward the apex. These striking muscular projections and deep intertrabecular recesses are characteristic of left ventricular noncompaction cardiomyopathy. The heart chambers and walls appear structurally altered due to this myocardial disorder.

blind.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of the heart showing significant ventricular remodeling. The right ventricle is markedly enlarged and distended, causing distortion in the shape and volume of the left ventricle. These structural abnormalities are characteristic of conditions causing severe right ventricular pressure or volume overload.
